observation: Logical LBA23 starts with DS01_XENOGEARS on source1 and DS02_XENOGEARS on source2; all remaining bytes in that 2048-byte block are zero. Independently proposed 7-byte records at LBA24 decode as a 24-bit little-endian LBA and signed 32-bit candidate length. All 43 negative records per disc have magnitudes exactly matching consecutive positive child records with matching start LBA. Source1 has 3728 positive entries; source2 has 3723. Every positive extent has an XA EOF under at least one tested 2048/2336-byte unit, and ISO CNF/executable LBA/size pairs match unique slots exactly. Source1 terminal candidate (0xffffff,0) occurs at slot4151; source2 at4146, followed by zeros. Nonzero zero-length markers and empty slots are preserved.
interpretation: The explicit DS01/DS02 labels confirm disc sequence directly. The candidate physical index layout is strongly supported by independent boot and XA boundary checks, but loader access, group/directory semantics, small-file size units, auxiliary LBA40 values and every gameplay category remain unresolved. The public source-slot catalog is not a game-content coverage claim.

preconditions: Independent original ISO boot and raw-sector EOF measurements
validation.expected: Explicit DS01/DS02 marker; 43 valid negative-count groups per profile; unique exact CNF/executable entries; no positive candidate without a measured EOF under either tested unit; retain unknown/padding slots and terminal marker.
validation.actual: All stated structural cross-checks passed for both originals. Parent independently observed both LBA23 labels. Parser bounds, negative-count consistency, unknown-slot preservation and terminal/truncation rejection passed original synthetic tests.
validation.tolerance: Exact static bytes/counts/coordinates. No runtime resource-ID, loader-decompilation, game-state or behavioral equivalence asserted.

limitations: Slots are source coordinates/project keys, not recovered runtime content IDs.
Negative counts match consecutive entries; directory meaning needs loader evidence.
EOF checks corroborate boundaries; size units remain ambiguous for small files.
Zero slots/length markers retain unknown meaning and are never executed as no-ops.
No field, battle, menu, audio, FMV, save or minigame meaning is assigned here.
This read-only inventory probe is not a game decoder, extractor or native loader.
